title: Godavari Pushkaralu 2027

format.style: low-poly 3D, warm golden-hour light, saffron + river-blue palette

voice.caption_style: word-by-word, current word in orange, white outline

scenes.title: LOGO & TAGLINE CONTEST
scenes.narration: Godavari Pushkaralu ki logo, tagline meeru design chesthe - gelisthe laksha rupaayalu!
scenes.visual: Hook shot: a blank glowing logo frame floats above the Godavari at sunrise, a pencil sketches a wave-and-diya mark inside it, gold coins burst out with Rs 1,00,000
scenes.camera: fast push-in then settle (first 2 seconds must grab attention)

scenes.title: RS 1 LAKH - 50,000 - 25,000
scenes.narration: Modhati bahumathi laksha, rendo bahumathi yabhai velu, moodo bahumathi iravai aidu velu.
scenes.visual: Three low-poly podium blocks (1, 2, 3) on a ghat, each with a trophy and prize amount floating above
scenes.camera: slow lateral dolly across the podiums

scenes.title: 30 NOVEMBER, 5 PM
scenes.narration: November 30 saayanthram aidu gantala lopu, godavaripushkaralutg at gmail dot com ki pampandi.
scenes.visual: Calendar prop flipping to NOVEMBER 30 (2026) with a clock showing 5:00; an envelope flies off toward an email address card
scenes.note: Keep the email on screen for at least 3 seconds so viewers can screenshot it

scenes.title: ASALU PUSHKARALU ANTE?
scenes.narration: Asalu ee Pushkaralu enti? Enduku inta pedda panduga? Choodandi.
scenes.visual: Transition: the logo frame dissolves into the river, camera dives toward the water
scenes.camera: fast dive into the water, cut to the next scene

scenes.title: GODAVARI PUSHKARALU
scenes.narration: Pannendu samvatsaralaku okkasari vache maha panduga - Godavari Pushkaralu.
scenes.visual: Wide sunrise shot of a low-poly river with temple gopuram on the bank, diyas floating on water

scenes.title: JUPITER ENTERS SIMHA
scenes.narration: Guru graham Simha raasi loki pravesinchinappudu, Godavari ki Pushkaralu vasthayi.
scenes.visual: Stylised night sky: glowing Jupiter sphere moving along a zodiac ring into the Leo (Simha) segment
scenes.camera: slow orbit around the zodiac ring

scenes.tag: Map: Natural Earth (public domain) - heights exaggerated
scenes.title: DAKSHINA GANGA
scenes.narration: Maharashtra nunchi Telangana, Andhra meedugaa samudram varaku - dakshina Ganga Godavari.
scenes.visual: Extruded map of Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh; glowing blue line traces the Godavari from source to Bay of Bengal
scenes.camera: top-down, slow tilt as the river line animates
scenes.note: Make the DHARMAPURI callout slightly bigger/brighter than the others - it is the local anchor of this video

scenes.title: A HOLY DIP
scenes.narration: Ee pannendu rojullo snanam chesthe, papalu potayani nammakam.
scenes.visual: Devotees on ghat steps stepping into water, marigold garlands, brass lotas
scenes.camera: low angle at water level, gentle dolly

scenes.title: MAHA PUSHKARAM
scenes.narration: 2015 lo jarigindi Maha Pushkaram - 144 samvatsaralaku okkasari vasthundani nammakam.
scenes.visual: Calendar prop flipping to JULY 14, 2015 (make sure the calendar matches the title)
scenes.note: The 144-year 'Maha Pushkaram' status is a belief disputed by some almanac writers, so the line says it is believed.

scenes.title: OVER 10 CRORE DIPS
scenes.narration: Pannendu rojullo padi kotla mandi paiga snanam chesaaru.
scenes.visual: Huge instanced crowd along long river ghats, aerial view, counter ticking up to 10,00,00,000+

scenes.title: 26 JUNE - 7 JULY 2027
scenes.narration: Ippudu malli 2027 lo - June 26 nunchi July 7 varaku.
scenes.visual: Calendar prop flipping to JUNE 26, 2027 with marigold border

scenes.tag: Map: Natural Earth (public domain) - heights exaggerated
scenes.title: 96 LOCATIONS - 8 CRORE DEVOTEES
scenes.narration: Telangana lo thombhai aaru pradesaalu, enimidi kotla mandi bhakthulu vasthaarani anchana.
scenes.visual: Telangana map with the Godavari, 96 small pins popping up along the river

scenes.title: DHARMAPURI
scenes.narration: Mana Dharmapuri lo Godavari Dakshina Vahini ga pravahisthundi - anduke ikkada snanam entho punyam.
scenes.visual: Low-poly Dharmapuri ghat at sunrise, river visibly bending, devotees on the steps, temple gopuram behind; the river turns to flow south (toward the viewer) at the ghat
scenes.camera: slow aerial follow along the river bend, then settle on the ghat

scenes.title: SRI LAKSHMI NARASIMHA SWAMY
scenes.narration: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy darshanam, Godavari snanam - rendu okkachote.
scenes.visual: Temple gopuram and mandapam in warm lamplight, bells, marigold garlands, devotees walking up from the ghat

scenes.title: RS 226 CRORE - 470 M NEW GHATS
scenes.narration: Dharmapuri lo nalugu vandala muppai metarla kotha ghatlu, rendu vandala iravai aaru kotla panulu.
scenes.visual: New ghat steps extending along the bank with a glowing measuring line labelled 470 m, cranes and workers
scenes.camera: lateral dolly along the length of the new ghat

scenes.title: RS 1,000 CRORE WORKS
scenes.narration: Kumbh Mela laaga, veyyi kotla rupaayalatho pani modalaindi.
scenes.visual: Construction scene: new ghat steps, cranes, barricades, CCTV poles, tent city by the river

scenes.title: ANTYA PUSHKARALU
scenes.visual: Same river as scene 1 but at sunset, single diya floating away

scenes.title: DHARMAPURI LO KALUDDAAM
scenes.narration: Meeru mee life lo okkasaraina Pushkaralaki vellara? Comments lo pettandi.
scenes.visual: Godavari Harathi on the Dharmapuri ghat at night, lamps raised, river glowing
scenes.note: Add the contest deadline as a small lower-third: Logo contest - last date 30 Nov, 5 PM

sources: Deccan Chronicle / The Hans India (Nov 2026): Telangana Endowments Dept logo & tagline contest; entries Nov 21-30, 5 PM; prizes Rs 1 lakh, 50,000, 25,000; godavaripushkaralutg@gmail.com
AP government GO (Dec 2025): Godavari Pushkarams 26 June - 7 July 2027
Telangana Cabinet Sub-Committee (Mar 2026): ~8 crore devotees, 96 locations; Antya Pushkaralu 13-24 July 2028
Telangana Today (Aug 2026): Rs 1,000 crore allocated, works from September 2026
The Hans India: Telangana minister confirms 26 June - 7 July 2027; Dharmapuri works Rs 226 crore, 470 m new ghats
Wikipedia (Dharmapuri, Telangana) and Natural Earth river course: the Godavari flows north to south at Dharmapuri, so it is Dakshina Vahini; Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy temple
Business Standard / Wikipedia: 2015 Maha Pushkaram, 14-25 July 2015, 10-11 crore dips; the 144-year Maha Pushkaram status is disputed
removed: Scene 11 (2015 Rajahmundry stampede, 'In memory') removed at the creator's request.
